pages.name: Silence in the Circle
pages.description: Inside the circle, the sound of rain and the smell of wet earth disappear. A motionless droplet hangs in the air, and a small empty bottle lies in the grass beneath it.

options.description: Catch the droplet in the bottle

pages.name: Rain in a Bottle
pages.description: The droplet falls into the bottle and breaks into countless tiny drops. A quiet rain now falls continuously inside the glass, but the water never fills the vessel.

pages.name: Sudden Downpour
pages.description: The droplet bursts, and a real downpour drenches the dry circle for a few seconds.

scenePatch.description: The ground inside the circle is wet, but the new rain once again avoids it.
